data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew word 'ḥanan', meaning 'grace', 'favor'. Avner is a biblical name for the son of Ner, a great man of valor and the chief of the tribe of Judah in the Old Testament. He was a wise and trusted counselor to King Saul. The name Avner carries the meaning “Bright; shinning one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew. Parents who choose Avner usually hope their child will grow to embody bright; shinning one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
